determine_the_distance_and_hose — VLM GRADING CRITERIA

Assess the completed flexible hose marked with masking tape for length, with its matching MS fitting assembly visible in the image. Evaluate each criterion independently as PASS or FAIL.

Criteria
1. Masking tape band is wrapped around the hose, encircling it fully
2. Tape band edges are square to the hose axis, not spiralling
3. A tape measure or rule appears in frame with the hose
4. Hose lay line dash number and a fitting dash number are both legible

Critical defects
- Hose is already cut or slit at the tape mark
- Hose shows a kink, crushed section, or cover cut through to braid
- Fitting dash number visibly differs from the hose lay line dash number

Overall decision
Overall PASS requires every required criterion to pass and no critical defect. Mark an unobservable required criterion “FAIL — not demonstrated in image.” Evaluate only visible evidence and do not infer hidden measurements, internal damage, torque, pressure, or test results.

cut_the_hose — VLM GRADING CRITERIA
Assess the completed flexible hose cut to length with the cut end exposed and tape removed visible in the image. Evaluate each criterion independently as PASS or FAIL.

Criteria
1. Hose remains partially joined at the cut location by uncut cover or core material.
2. Cut face is visibly sloped or angled across the hose cross-section.
3. Cut end exhibits ragged, torn, or uneven cover material along the edge.
4. Masking tape remains wrapped around the hose surface at the cut end.
5. The finished work shows this defect: Wire braid is frayed and splayed outward from the cut face.
6. The finished work shows this defect: Cut face is visibly crushed or flattened out of round.
7. The finished work shows this defect: Cut is partial, with the hose still joined at the cut line.

Overall decision
Overall PASS requires every required criterion to pass and no critical defect. Mark an unobservable required criterion “FAIL — not demonstrated in image.” Evaluate only visible evidence and do not infer hidden measurements, internal damage, torque, pressure, or test results.

assemble_the_end_fitting — VLM GRADING CRITERIA
Assess the completed hose end with its socket and nipple assembled as an MS end fitting visible in the image. Evaluate each criterion independently as PASS or FAIL.

Criteria
1. Socket is partially threaded onto the hose end, exposing bare wire braid between the socket end and the hose cover.
2. Nipple hex is bottomed tight against the socket face in flush metal-to-metal contact.
3. Nipple is driven into the socket body until its hex is recessed inside the socket mouth.
4. Hose cover extends unstripped to the cut hose end, overlapping into the socket threads.
5. Hose cover beyond the stripped band is gouged and split open to the braid.
6. Hose enters the socket mouth at an angle, crushed flat and kinked at the fitting entry.
7. The finished work shows this defect: Wire braid strands are cut, splayed or unwound in the stripped band.
8. The finished work shows this defect: Socket is on the hose with an open bore and no nipple installed.
9. The finished work shows this defect: Nipple hex is bottomed flush against the socket with no gap.
10. The finished work shows this defect: Inner tube is split, torn or extruded out of the fitting.
11. The finished work shows this defect: Hose is kinked or collapsed where it enters the socket.

Overall decision
Overall PASS requires every required criterion to pass and no critical defect. Mark an unobservable required criterion “FAIL — not demonstrated in image.” Evaluate only visible evidence and do not infer hidden measurements, internal damage, torque, pressure, or test results.

proof_test_the_hose_assembly — VLM GRADING CRITERIA
Assess the completed flexible hose assembly capped and pressurized on the hydraulic hose test stand visible in the image. Evaluate each criterion independently as PASS or FAIL.

Criteria
1. One end fitting of the hose assembly hangs disconnected away from the test stand port.
2. The opposite end fitting presents an open, unsealed port with exposed threads.
3. A test stand temperature gauge is visible in frame with the assembly.
4. The gauge pointer rests directly on zero, showing zero pressure.
5. Hose cover, socket-to-hose junctions, and fittings show visible fluid weeping and wet droplets.
6. The pressurized hose contains a severe kink and sharp bend along its run.
7. The finished work shows this defect: Fluid is spraying or dripping from a fitting or the hose cover.
8. The finished work shows this defect: The hose end opposite the stand is open, with no cap or plug fitted.
9. The finished work shows this defect: The hose cover is burst, blistered, or wire braid is protruding.
10. The finished work shows this defect: A socket has pulled away from the hose, leaving a gap.
11. The finished work shows this defect: The pressurized hose is kinked or collapsed at a sharp bend.

Overall decision
Overall PASS requires every required criterion to pass and no critical defect. Mark an unobservable required criterion “FAIL — not demonstrated in image.” Evaluate only visible evidence and do not infer hidden measurements, internal damage, torque, pressure, or test results.
